data.fund_name: DSP Global Clean Energy Overseas Equity Omni FoF
data.fund_type: An open ended Fund of Fund scheme investing in overseas Funds/ ETFs investing in companies involved in the alternative energy sector.
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the Scheme is to seek capital appreciation by investing in units of overseas Funds/ ETFs investing in companies involved in the alternative energy sector. The Scheme may also invest a certain portion of its corpus in cash & cash equivalents securities, in order to meet liquidity requirements from time to time. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: 1. Units of overseas Funds and ETFs investing in companies involved in the alternative energy sector: 95% to 100% 2. Cash & Cash Equivalents: 0% - 5%
data.benchmark: MSCI ACWI IMI Clean Energy Infrastructure Index
